title: KiwiRiser
tagline: This project extends the plugins for Apeworx by providing a plugin for Blockscout explorer to increase the diversity.
description: This project extends the plugins for Apeworx by providing a plugin for Blockscout explorer to increase the diversity. It forks the project-template ensuring this is a valid plugin for ape-works. From there I tested out the endpoints for Blockscout and found they do support Vyper smart contracts and have similar accessibility to smart contract verification with sourcify.
how_its_made: This project extends the plugins for Apeworx by providing a plugin for Blockscout explorer to increase the diversity of explorers supported for the environment. It uses python. It has been hosted on Radicle-cli. Radicle-cli provides a decentralized way to store code with allows for trustless collaboration.
